title: 第3章 隐忍第4章 纠纷
slug: 横推九世诸位女帝一直在等我
content_zh:
“冷静，冷静，待到古路之内，必杀他！”叶河心中努力压制着自己的情绪。
狂野星是狂龙帝朝某位古帝之子，自封到这一世，但由于修炼出了岔子，导致肉身溃烂。
如此，他便外出寻找合适的肉身，刚好叶河的弟弟叶星有着尚未觉醒的霸天圣体，被狂野星直接夺舍，连同全村人也都被狂野星杀光，若不是叶河恰好不在，不然也会惨遭毒手。
他修炼的目的，便是斩杀狂野星，覆灭狂龙帝朝。
曾经的他得知了狂野星的身份之后，一度陷入了绝望之中。
因为，狂野星太强了，也可以说，狂龙帝朝太强了。
但现在，他已经与狂野星是同样的修为了，狂野星虽然已经在登天境巅峰压制许久，随时便可入圣，但叶河不惧与他，他自信自己在同境界无敌。
最大的困难其实就是，他的身份依旧不如狂野星。
原因无它，狂野星是真正的禁忌帝子，有着狂龙帝朝皇室直系血脉。
但叶河不是落天教的嫡系，他不可能可以依靠落天教向狂龙帝朝宣战。
落天教也不可能为了他去向狂龙帝朝翻脸。
而且狂龙帝朝与落天教还有些交情，让他被迫与狂野星握手言和。
但他不甘心！他心中一直计划着在通天古路之内斩杀狂野星，出来之时便使用后手逃走，待到他实力足够，必定会覆灭整个狂龙帝朝。
“父亲、母亲、弟弟，还有大家，我定会为你们复仇……一定！”叶河心中又一次默念他这些年来一直默念之事。
“哟，又生气了，我早已说过，我若不夺舍你弟弟，他这辈子都不会觉醒霸天圣体，寿元不过百岁，现在也早已离世。”
“你现在看看我，是不是会想起自己弟弟？”
狂野星带着笑意的声音传到叶河耳中，字字诛心，叶河死死握紧拳头，眼中布满血丝。
“隐忍！现在还不能翻脸，待到了通天古路内，他定会死在我手上！”
叶河强行压着自己内心的杀意，冷声道：“到了通天古路，你我必有一战！”
“呵呵，我很期待。”狂野星讥笑一声，他根本没把叶河放在眼里，区区平民出身罢了，当年若是他在，连他一起杀了。

对他来说，杀死几个平民，是一件在小不过的事，他能看上叶星的肉身，是他的荣幸。
忽地，在他们正上方出现了一道巨大的旋涡，散发出的气息无比强大。
那正是通天古路的入口。
这时，守护者出现了，他朗声道：“入口已开，诸位自行进入，但要记得，一旦进去了若是出来，便是弃权。”
“秘境入口会维持三天，三天过后便是只出不进。”
“好了，诸位进去吧。”
随着守护者话音落下，众人纷纷纵身一跃，进入了旋涡之内。
人数虽然多，但还是很有规矩的，身后势力强大的天骄便可在前，那些小势力只能等。
“仙庭之主为何每次都来此观望？”在一众大教之内，一位中年男子悄悄的对身边老者问道。
他看着前方一所悬浮于虚空的宫殿，眼中满是敬畏。
那可是仙庭的帝器仙殿，也只有仙庭之主能在内歇息。
仙庭，仙界公认的最强势力之一，相传当年差点统一仙界，不过应该是传言。
“不知，仙庭之主前两次开启便已经出现在此，按理说这些禁忌天骄的战斗在这位无上帝者面前不过是小打小闹吧。”老者也表示疑惑。
这时，守护者大手一挥，通天古路内的场景便展示在了诸位道统领队之人手中的观影石。
观影石可以映照通天古路内的场景，每个道统多少都有一个。
此物只有守护者有激活，他人无法催动。
content_en:
"Calm down, calm down. Once inside the ancient road, I will kill him!" Ye He tried hard to suppress his emotions.
Wild Star is the son of an ancient emperor from the Mad Dragon Emperor Dynasty. He has proclaimed himself in this life, but due to a mistake in his training, his body was rotten.
In this way, he went out to look for a suitable body. It happened that Ye He's younger brother Ye Xing had an unawakened Tyrant Holy Body, and was directly snatched away by the Wild Star. The entire village was also killed by the Wild Star. If Ye He hadn't happened to be away, he would have been brutally murdered.
The purpose of his training is to kill Wild Star and destroy the Mad Dragon Emperor Dynasty.
After he learned the identity of Wild Star, he once fell into despair.
Because Wild Star is too strong, it can also be said that Mad Dragon Emperor Dynasty is too strong.
But now, he is at the same level of cultivation as Wild Star. Although Wild Star has been suppressed at the peak of Heaven Realm for a long time and can become a saint at any time, Ye He is not afraid to fight him. He is confident that he is invincible in the same realm.
The biggest difficulty is actually that his status is still not as good as Wild Star.
There is no other reason. Wild Star is the true son of the forbidden emperor and has a direct bloodline from the royal family of the Mad Dragon Emperor.
But Ye He is not a direct descendant of the Luotian Sect, and it is impossible for him to rely on the Luotian Sect to declare war on the Kuanglong Emperor.
It is impossible for the Luotian Sect to turn against the Kuanglong Emperor for him.
Moreover, Kuang Long Emperor Chao still had some friendship with Luotian Sect, so he was forced to make peace with Wild Star.
But he is not willing to give in! He had always planned in his heart to kill Wild Star within the Ancient Road to Heaven, and when he came out, he would use his backhand to escape. When he was strong enough, he would definitely destroy the entire Mad Dragon Emperor Dynasty.
"Father, mother, brother, and everyone else, I will definitely avenge you...for sure!" Ye He once again thought silently in his heart what he had been thinking silently for all these years.
"Hey, I'm angry again. I've already said that if I didn't seize your brother's body, he would never awaken the Tyrant Holy Body in this life. His lifespan would only be a hundred years old, and he would have passed away long ago."
"When you look at me now, do you think of your brother?"
Wild Star's smiling voice reached Ye He's ears, and every word was heartbreaking. Ye He clenched his fists tightly and his eyes were bloodshot.
"Be patient! Don't fall out now. When he reaches the Tongtian Ancient Road, he will definitely die in my hands!"
Ye He suppressed the murderous intention in his heart and said coldly: "When we reach the Tongtian Ancient Road, you and I will have a battle!"
"Haha, I'm looking forward to it." Wild Star sneered. He didn't take Ye He seriously at all. He was just a commoner. If he had been here back then, he would have killed him too.
For him, killing a few civilians was nothing but a trivial matter. It was his honor to be able to set his sights on Ye Xing's body.
Suddenly, a huge vortex appeared directly above them, and the aura it exuded was extremely powerful.
That is the entrance to Tongtian Ancient Road.
At this time, the guardian appeared, and he said loudly: "The entrance has been opened, you can enter on your own, but remember, once you enter, if you come out, you will give up."
"The entrance to the secret realm will remain open for three days. After three days, it will be impossible to get out."
"Okay, everyone, come in."
As the guardian's words fell, everyone jumped into the vortex.
Although there are many people, they are still very well behaved. The powerful geniuses behind them can go in front, while those small forces can only wait.
"Why does the Lord of the Immortal Court come here to watch every time?" Among the great sects, a middle-aged man quietly asked the old man next to him.
He looked at a palace suspended in the void in front of him, his eyes full of awe.
That is the Immortal Palace of Immortal Palace, and only the Lord of the Immortal Palace can rest there.
Immortal Court, recognized as one of the strongest forces in the Immortal World, was said to have almost unified the Immortal World back then, but that was probably just a rumor.
"I don't know, the Lord of the Immortal Court has already appeared here twice before he opened it. It stands to reason that the battles between these taboo geniuses are just a small fight in front of this godless man." The old man also expressed doubts.
At this time, the guardian waved his hand, and the scene in the Tongtian Ancient Road was displayed on the viewing stones in the hands of the Taoist leaders.
The viewing stones can reflect the scenes in the Tongtian Ancient Road, and each Taoist tradition has one.
Only the guardian can activate this object, others cannot activate it.
